Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. At the plant description, add its colour and shape to make the setting vivid: “那儿开着黄色的花，像星星一样。”
2. After seeing the beautiful plant, add Shennong’s immediate feeling or thought: “神农觉得很奇怪，心想：这种植物会不会能做药呢？”
3. When introducing his wish to help others, add a short line of inner speech: “他想：我要学会治病，帮助生病的人。”

ideas.reason: It adds a simple, concrete visual detail that fits the scene and is correct Chinese.
“会不会能做药” is unnatural; say “这种植物能不能做药呢？” instead.
The learner already says that Shennong wants to become a doctor and help sick people.
